title_original: Parigi oltre la fiera: 15 mostre da visitare tra musei e fondazioni
editorial_title_zh: 超越博览会的巴黎：15个不容错过的博物馆与基金会展览
editorial_excerpt_zh: 从皮诺私人收藏馆（Bourse de Commerce）到奥赛博物馆，途经卢浮宫和卡地亚基金会。这是一份在巴黎艺术巴塞尔（Art Basel）期间以及整个秋季带您穿梭于城市中的指南，聚焦大师之作与当代艺术主角。文章《超越博览会的巴黎：15个展览…
editorial_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "如果说巴黎大皇宫（Grand Palais）是巴黎艺术巴塞尔周期间众人环绕的起点，那它绝非唯一的目的地。一如往年，艺术超越了博览会的展位，延续到了各大声誉卓著的博物馆和基金会的展厅之中。丰富多彩的日程汇聚了绘画、摄影、电影到当代装置艺术等15场活动，带您领略超越博览会的巴黎：它是一场邀请，让我们以全新而不同的视角审视大师之作，去探索和沉浸于意料之外的艺术家与艺术之路。", "links": [{"text": "Art Basel Parigi", "url": "https://www.exibart.com/mercato/tutti-a-parigi-la-guida-completa-ad-art-basel-paris-2026/amp/"}], "translated": true}, {"type": "heading", "text": "皮诺私人收藏馆的“记住我”（2026年10月7日 – 2027年1月18日）", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "皮诺私人收藏馆呈现了一场盛大的群展，汇集了来自皮诺收藏（Collection Pinault）的80位艺术家的700多件作品。展览路线贯穿摄影史，不遵循年代顺序，围绕记忆、肖像、身体、构图和消逝，在不同时代与流派之间建立对话。丰富多样的并置邀请人们重新发现那些著名的影像并以不同的方式去观察它们，从而认识到摄影既是见证，也是记忆的建构。", "translated": true}, {"type": "heading", "text": "卡地亚当代艺术基金会的易卜拉欣·马哈马：“收获的时代”（2026年10月22日 – 2027年2月28日）", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "“收获的时代”呈现了加纳艺术家易卜拉欣·马哈马（Ibrahim Mahama）的作品。他以利用废旧材料、织物、黄麻、文献及劳工相关物品创作纪念碑式装置而闻名。展览将这些材料转化为大型空间装置，探讨殖民主义、人口流动、商业、记忆以及非洲城市的转型，邀请公众穿行于物质档案与社会景观之中，让那些往往被边缘化的历史重回人们的视野。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://www.exibart.com/repository/media/2026/10/FONDATION-CARTIER-Ibrahim-Mahama-Parliament-of-Ghosts-2023-foin-Red-Clay-Tamale-©-Ibrahim-Mahama-photo-©-Ernest-Sackitey-courtesy-Red-Clay-1024x683.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "FONDATION CARTIER – Ibrahim Mahama, Parliament of Ghosts, 2023, foin, Red Clay, Tamale © Ibrahim Mahama photo © Ernest Sackitey, courtesy Red Clay", "credit": "Exibart", "translated": true}, {"type": "heading", "text": "小皇宫的埃娃·贡萨莱斯（2026年9月15日 – 2027年1月24日）", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "在小皇宫，埃娃·贡萨莱斯（Eva Gonzalès）终于走到了舞台中央：她不再仅仅是马奈的学生，而是法国绘画关键时期的主角。展览通过肖像画、室内景、静物以及日常生活场景，回溯了她短暂而热烈的艺术生涯。在这些作品中，印象派的遗产与个人视野交织在一起，既现代又敏感，充满了亲密的氛围、低调的姿态和精致的构图。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://www.exibart.com/repository/media/2026/10/WhatsApp-Image-2026-10-22-at-10.11.16-1024x763.jpeg", "alt": "", "caption": "Eva Gonzalès, Une loge aux Italiens, v. 1874. "国立网球场现代美术馆为斯坦·道格拉斯举办了一场大型个人回顾展，通过摄影、电影、录像和装置作品贯穿其研究历程。这位加拿大艺术家的作品探讨了历史是如何被构建和传递的，交织了探索社会、政治和文化紧张关系的纪录片与虚构。其中音乐被赋予了重要作用，尤其是爵士乐，被用作应对种族、阶级和不平等问题的工具。", "translated": true}, {"type": "heading", "text": Photo © Sam Basu", "credit": "Exibart", "translated": true}, {"type": "heading", "text": "古斯塔夫·法耶：收藏家、创造者，路易威登基金会（2026年10月9日 – 2027年3月8日）", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "伟大收藏的背后不仅是作品的财富：还有能够指引一个时代审美品味的相遇、直觉和选择。路易威登基金会重构了高更、梵高和雷东的收藏家、同时也是艺术家和企业家的古斯塔夫·法耶的世界。展览将他收集的杰作与他的陶瓷、吸水纸上的水彩画、地毯和插图书并置展出，突显出收藏与创造力之间的对话。", "translated": true}, {"type": "heading", "text": "克劳德·莫奈：内在的革命，橘园美术馆（2026年10月14日 – 2027年3月8日）", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "在杜伊勒里花园的中心，橘园美术馆通过一场献给克劳德·莫奈的展览回归其身份的核心，莫奈的《睡莲》一直是该美术馆无可争议的主角。展览探究其绘画内部的革命：不仅仅是光线和风景，还有主题在感知体验中的逐渐解体。这是一个将莫奈重新视为现代抽象伟大先驱之一的机会，与保存了他艺术遗嘱的场所进行对话。", "translated": true}, {"type": "heading", "text": "辉煌的贝尔蒙多，法国电影资料馆（2026年10月7日 – 2027年1月31日）", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "+1以防艺术展之旅还不够的话。法国电影资料馆通过由家庭档案、照片、海报、服装和未公开文件构建的路线向让-保罗·贝尔蒙多致敬。展览重溯了这位演员从戏剧训练到让-吕克·戈达尔的《筋疲力尽》这一转折点的崛起，直至他作为大众明星、特技替身以及动作敏捷、反传统演员的神话构建，他能够自如地从新浪潮过渡到动作喜剧。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://www.exibart.com/repository/media/2026/10/CINEMATEQUE-FR-Photographie-de-lexposition-by-Stéphane-Dabrowski-La-Cinémathèque-française-1024x687.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "INEMATEQUE FR – Photographie de l’exposition by Stéphane Dabrowski – La Cinémathèque française", "credit": "Exibart", "translated": true}]
article_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "Se il Grand Palais è il punto di partenza attorno al quale orbita la settimana di Art Basel Parigi , non è di certo l’unica destinazione. Come ogni anno, l’arte supera gli stand della fiera e prosegue tra le sale dei musei e delle fondazioni più prestigiosi, attraverso un ricco programma che accosta grandi maestri, artiste da riscoprire, celebri attori e protagonisti del contemporaneo. Quindici appuntamenti, dalla pittura alla fotografia, dal cinema alle installazioni contemporanee, per attraversare Parigi oltre la fiera: un invito a guardare i grandi maestri sotto una nuova e diversa luce, a esplorare e perdersi in artisti e percorsi inaspettati.", "links": [{"text": "Art Basel Parigi", "url": "https://www.exibart.com/mercato/tutti-a-parigi-la-guida-completa-ad-art-basel-paris-2026/amp/"}]}, {"type": "heading", "text": "Remember Me alla Bourse de Commerce (7 ottobre 2026 – 18 gennaio 2027)"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "La Bourse de Commerce presenta una grande mostra collettiva che riunisce oltre 700 opere di 80 artisti provenienti dalla Collezione Pinault. Il percorso attraversa la storia della fotografia senza seguire una cronologia, costruendo dialoghi tra epoche e generi intorno a memoria, ritratto, corpo, composizione e scomparsa. La ricchezza degli accostamenti invita a ritrovare immagini celebri e a osservarle diversamente, riconoscendo nella fotografia tanto una testimonianza quanto una costruzione della memoria."}, {"type": "heading", "text": "Ibrahim Mahama. Le temps des récoltes alla Fondation Cartier pour l’art contemporain (22 ottobre 2026 – 28 febbraio 2027)"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Le temps des récoltes presenta il lavoro di Ibrahim Mahama, artista ghanese noto per installazioni monumentali realizzate con materiali di scarto, tessuti, juta, documenti e oggetti legati al lavoro. La mostra trasforma questi materiali in grandi dispositivi spaziali che parlano di colonialismo, migrazioni, commercio, memoria e trasformazione delle città africane, invitando il pubblico a percorrere archivi materiali e paesaggi sociali, restituendo visibilità a storie spesso marginalizzate."}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://www.exibart.com/repository/media/2026/10/FONDATION-CARTIER-Ibrahim-Mahama-Parliament-of-Ghosts-2023-foin-Red-Clay-Tamale-©-Ibrahim-Mahama-photo-©-Ernest-Sackitey-courtesy-Red-Clay-1024x683.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "FONDATION CARTIER – Ibrahim Mahama, Parliament of Ghosts, 2023, foin, Red Clay, Tamale © Ibrahim Mahama photo © Ernest Sackitey, courtesy Red Clay", "credit": "Exibart"}, {"type": "heading", "text": "Eva Gonzalès al Petit Palais (15 settembre 2026 – 24 gennaio 2027)"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Al Petit Palais, Eva Gonzalès giunge finalmente al centro della scena: non più soltanto allieva di Manet, ma protagonista di una stagione cruciale della pittura francese. article_text:
Se il Grand Palais è il punto di partenza attorno al quale orbita la settimana di Art Basel Parigi , non è di certo l’unica destinazione. Come ogni anno, l’arte supera gli stand della fiera e prosegue tra le sale dei musei e delle fondazioni più prestigiosi, attraverso un ricco programma che accosta grandi maestri, artiste da riscoprire, celebri attori e protagonisti del contemporaneo. Quindici appuntamenti, dalla pittura alla fotografia, dal cinema alle installazioni contemporanee, per attraversare Parigi oltre la fiera: un invito a guardare i grandi maestri sotto una nuova e diversa luce, a esplorare e perdersi in artisti e percorsi inaspettati.

Remember Me alla Bourse de Commerce (7 ottobre 2026 – 18 gennaio 2027)

La Bourse de Commerce presenta una grande mostra collettiva che riunisce oltre 700 opere di 80 artisti provenienti dalla Collezione Pinault. Il percorso attraversa la storia della fotografia senza seguire una cronologia, costruendo dialoghi tra epoche e generi intorno a memoria, ritratto, corpo, composizione e scomparsa. La ricchezza degli accostamenti invita a ritrovare immagini celebri e a osservarle diversamente, riconoscendo nella fotografia tanto una testimonianza quanto una costruzione della memoria.

Ibrahim Mahama. Le temps des récoltes alla Fondation Cartier pour l’art contemporain (22 ottobre 2026 – 28 febbraio 2027)

Le temps des récoltes presenta il lavoro di Ibrahim Mahama, artista ghanese noto per installazioni monumentali realizzate con materiali di scarto, tessuti, juta, documenti e oggetti legati al lavoro. La mostra trasforma questi materiali in grandi dispositivi spaziali che parlano di colonialismo, migrazioni, commercio, memoria e trasformazione delle città africane, invitando il pubblico a percorrere archivi materiali e paesaggi sociali, restituendo visibilità a storie spesso marginalizzate.

Eva Gonzalès al Petit Palais (15 settembre 2026 – 24 gennaio 2027)

Al Petit Palais, Eva Gonzalès giunge finalmente al centro della scena: non più soltanto allieva di Manet, ma protagonista di una stagione cruciale della pittura francese. La mostra ripercorre la sua breve ma intensa carriera, attraverso ritratti, interni, nature morte e scene di vita quotidiana, nei quali l’eredità impressionista si intreccia con uno sguardo personale, al tempo stesso moderno e sensibile, fatto di atmosfere intime, gesti discreti e composizioni raffinate.

Zurbarán al Musée du Louvre (7 ottobre 2026 – 25 gennaio 2027)

La retrospettiva del Louvre, realizzata con la National Gallery di Londra e l’Art Institute di Chicago, riunisce 65 dipinti per raccontare la carriera di Francisco de Zurbarán, tra i protagonisti della pittura spagnola del Seicento. Il percorso accosta le grandi commissioni monastiche andaluse ai ritratti, alle figure di sante e alle nature morte, riservando spazio anche alla produzione del figlio Juan. Ne emerge un artista che coniuga la semplificazione dei volumi con un naturalismo straordinariamente preciso, restituendo la consistenza dei tessuti, la presenza dei corpi e la bellezza degli oggetti quotidiani

Kerry James Marshall. The Histories al Musée d’Art Moderne de Paris (18 settembre 2026 – 24 gennaio 2027)

Nelle tele di Kerry James Marshall la vita quotidiana conquista le dimensioni e l’ambizione della pittura di storia. Un salone di bellezza, un parco o un interno domestico diventano luoghi in cui la presenza delle figure nere modifica le regole della rappresentazione. The Histories è la prima mostra monografica museale in Francia dedicata a questa artista e ne riunisce 70 opere che, attraversando oltre quattro decenni di lavoro, intrecciano memoria della schiavitù, diritti civili, cultura popolare e riferimenti alla tradizione occidentale.

Histoires de paysages. De Monet à Hockney (1890–2026) al Musée Marmottan Monet (24 settembre 2026 – 31 gennaio 2027)

Il paesaggio non è soltanto una veduta da contemplare: custodisce le tracce della storia, delle trasformazioni e dei conflitti che lo attraversano. Al Musée Marmottan Monet, la mostra in collaborazione con il Musée de Grenoble ripercorre questa relazione dal 1890 a oggi, intrecciando pittura, fotografia, scultura e video. Dai Nymphéas di Monet alle ricerche di Nicolas de Staël, Anna-Eva Bergman e David Hockney, il percorso esplora il confine tra natura e astrazione, i luoghi della memoria e le inquietudini della crisi ambientale.

Andy Warhol. La ligne et l’image al Musée du Luxembourg (16 settembre 2026 – 10 gennaio 2027)

La mostra esplora il ruolo del disegno e della linea nell’opera di Andy Warhol, spesso ridotto nell’immaginario collettivo alla serigrafia e alle icone pop. La linea è stata infatti per Warhol uno strumento costante di osservazione, riproduzione e trasformazione dell’immagine, dal disegno pubblicitario ed editoriale alle opere dedicate alle celebrità. Ne emerge un Warhol meno prevedibile, più grafico e sperimentale, attento alla circolazione delle immagini nella cultura di massa.

Éternel Tintoret al Musée Jacquemart-André (11 settembre 2026 – 24 gennaio 2027)

Il Musée Jacquemart-André presenta un panorama dell’intera carriera di Tintoretto attraverso una quarantina di dipinti e opere grafiche, che mettono in luce la varietà della sua produzione, dalle grandi composizioni religiose ai soggetti mitologici, dai ritratti agli studi preparatori. La mostra approfondisce inoltre la sua fortuna nella pittura francese dell’Ottocento, con opere di Ingres, Delacroix, Manet e Cézanne, evidenziando la continuità tra la sua libertà espressiva e le ricerche dei moderni.

Cézanne et nous al Grand Palais (23 settembre 2026 – 17 gennaio 2027)

Cézanne et nous al Grand Palais interroga l’eredità del pittore quale padre del modernismo, ma soprattutto quale pittore in grado di trasformare la percezione dello spazio, della luce e della materia mostrando come la ricerca di una forma possa cambiare il modo stesso di vedere. Il percorso mette in relazione le opere del maestro di Aix-en-Provence con la ricezione della sua lezione da parte di generazioni successive di artisti.

Mary Cassatt, l’indipendente al Musée d’Orsay (6 ottobre 2026 – 31 gennaio 2027)

Al Musée d’Orsay, Mary Cassatt emerge come voce originale dell’impressionismo: americana a Parigi, donna, artista e indipendente. La mostra esplora il suo universo di maternità, infanzia e relazioni femminili, trasformando scene quotidiane in immagini di grande intensità: dietro l’apparente delicatezza dei soggetti si rivelano una composizione rigorosa, un uso raffinato della luce e uno sguardo moderno.

Stan Douglas al Jeu de Paume (20 ottobre 2026 – 10 gennaio 2027)

Il Jeu de Paume dedica a Stan Douglas una vasta monografica che attraversa la sua ricerca attraverso fotografie, film, video e installazioni. Il lavoro dell’artista canadese indaga il modo in cui la storia viene costruita e trasmessa, intrecciando documentazione e finzione che esplorano tensioni sociali, politiche e culturali. Un ruolo significativo è affidato alla musica, in particolare al jazz, utilizzata come strumento per affrontare questioni di razza, classe e disuguaglianza.

Toi et ta bande al Palais de Tokyo (21 ottobre 2026 – 14 febbraio 2027)

Al Palais de Tokyo, Toi et ta bande riunisce una ventina di opere nate da pratiche artistiche e collettive radicate in territori rurali, montani e insulari, dalla Bretagna alla Guadalupa, dalle Cévennes ai Paesi Baschi. Al centro c’è il legame tra luoghi e comunità: atelier, cori, gruppi di lavoro e di lotta diventano occasioni per sperimentare altri modi di creare e vivere insieme. Tra riflessioni ecologiche e aspirazioni politiche, la mostra restituisce un’immagine della ruralità lontana dai cliché, non più semplice margine della città, ma spazio autonomo di ricerca e immaginazione.

Gustave Fayet, collectionneur, créateur alla Fondation Louis Vuitton (9 ottobre 2026 – 8 marzo 2027)

Dietro una grande collezione non c’è soltanto un patrimonio di opere: ci sono incontri, intuizioni e scelte che possono contribuire a orientare il gusto di un’epoca. La Fondation Louis Vuitton ricostruisce il mondo di Gustave Fayet, collezionista di Gauguin, Van Gogh e Redon, ma anche artista e imprenditore. Il percorso accosta i capolavori da lui raccolti alle sue ceramiche, agli acquerelli su carta assorbente, ai tappeti e ai libri illustrati, facendo emergere il dialogo tra collezione e creatività.

Claude Monet. La révolution intérieure al Musée de l’Orangerie (14 ottobre 2026 – 8 marzo 2027)

Nel cuore delle Tuileries, il Musée de l’Orangerie torna al nucleo della propria identità con una mostra dedicata a Claude Monet, le cui Ninfee sono da sempre le protagoniste indiscusse del museo. Il percorso indaga la rivoluzione interna alla sua pittura: non soltanto la luce e il paesaggio, ma la progressiva dissoluzione del soggetto nell’esperienza della percezione. Un’occasione per rivedere Monet come uno dei grandi precursori dell’astrazione moderna, in dialogo con il luogo che conserva il suo testamento artistico.

Belmondo, le Magnifique alla Cinémathèque française (7 ottobre 2026 – 31 gennaio 2027)

Un doveroso +1 semmai il giro delle mostre d’arte non fosse abbastanza. La Cinémathèque française rende omaggio a Jean-Paul Belmondo attraverso un percorso costruito con archivi familiari, fotografie, affiches, costumi e documenti inediti. La mostra ripercorre l’ascesa dell’attore dalla formazione teatrale alla svolta di Fino all’ultimo respiro di Jean-Luc Godard, fino alla costruzione del suo mytho di star popolare, stuntman e attore agile e anticonformista, capace di passare dalla Nouvelle Vague alla commedia d’azione.

article_text:
Indonesian studio giant MD Entertainment will release a sequel to its 2025 horror smash “ Pabrik Gula ” in early 2028 and has three Imax films planned for 2027, Astrid Wienardi, the company’s head of content licensing and global business, said Sunday at Taiwan Creative Content Fest (TCCF) in Taipei.

Wienardi delivered a presentation on how MD ties its film and series library to broadcast and streaming. The company took control of free-to-air channel NET TV in a deal worth up to $105 million and has brought in investment from Korea’s SBS.

Related Stories

'Stranger Things' Prequel Spinoff 'Other Worlds' Ordered to Series at Netflix

Alex de la Iglesia on His Upcoming Chilean Shoot ‘The Misunderstanding’: ‘Reality Has Become My Parallel World’

“Pabrik Gula” sold more than 5 million tickets in Indonesia before traveling to Vietnam, Cambodia, Singapore, Malaysia, Brunei, the U.S. and Europe. Its hooks and popularity persuaded MD to commit to a second installment.

The Imax relationship started with “Badarawuhi,” the prequel to “KKN di Desa Penari” and the first Southeast Asian film shot for the format. One of the three 2027 Imax titles will draw on “Dhot Design,” a YouTube animated series about four friends that pulls between 8 million and 10 million views an episode. Lionsgate and CJ are also among MD’s strategic partners.

Active for more than two decades across film, series, animation, music publishing and talent management, MD has more than 200 features to its name and plans 12 to 13 releases in 2027, led by horror alongside comedy and drama. “KKN di Desa Penari” sold 10.7 million tickets at home, an Indonesian record at the time.

“Ivanna 2” is due early next year. The original is a spinoff from MD’s “Danur” horror universe about a headless Dutch woman.

“‘Ivanna’ was moderately accepted in Indonesia market, but it did fascinatingly well in Vietnam,” Wienardi said. “It actually broke records in the theatrical Vietnamese market.”

Feedback from platform partners, along with fan comments on social media, decides whether MD extends a series, spins off a title or grows a franchise. Netflix drama “Ipar Adalah Maut,” which Wienardi translated as “Brother-in-Law Is Death,” topped the streamer’s trending list in its first week and stayed in the top 10 for seven straight weeks. A second season is in the works and could launch on Netflix next year.

MD has eight titles on Netflix and three on WeTV, where seven of the platform’s top 20 titles were MD productions, including “Layangan Putus,” which trended in 25 countries. On Prime Video, mother-daughter series “Induk Gajah” (“Mother Elephant”) earned a Season 2 order soon after its 2023 debut and helped pull in new subscribers. A deal with iQIYI, unveiled in mid-October, will see two titles roll out by December and a third in the first quarter of 2027.

Music is part of the playbook too. Netflix series “Suara Hati,” whose two lead actresses are dangdut singers, generated 100,000 first-week downloads across Spotify and YouTube Music, while “Bakti,” a song from “Danyang: Mahar Tukar Nyawa,” which opened Nov. 5, has passed 200,000 downloads on Spotify.

“The golden rule for us is that the universal appeal should never mean stripping away local identity,” Wienardi said. “Local identity is very important for MD. Without local identity, we lose the soul of the story.”

She added that CEO Manoj Punjabi demands that soul at every greenlight meeting, and that MD wants folklore-rooted horror rather than “watered-down thrillers or any Hollywood-like thrillers.”

When an audience member asked how Indonesian films command around 65% of local moviegoing while Taiwanese films account for just 10%-12% at home, Wienardi cited Indonesia’s population of roughly 280 million and a deep well of haunting folklore that parents pass to their children.

“We are surrounded by a lot of mountainous areas where the spiritual taboos are actually discussed on family dinners,” she said.

Horror, MD’s specialty for more than 20 years, is the genre that crosses borders most easily, according to Wienardi, who said it has at times reached the U.S. and European markets. “When it comes to drama, it’s a bit different because then, you know, there’s a lot of sayings in Indonesia that probably are not translated or culturally translated well,” she said.

The traffic runs both ways. MD released adaptations of Thai and Korean properties this year, partnered with Korea’s Barunson on “Sorop” and has fielded co-production inquiries from U.S. and European producers. Wienardi said the studio sees strong potential in bringing Taiwanese and East Asian IP to Indonesia, and wants pitches that arrive with proof of concept, a clear fit for Indonesian viewers and a track record in their home market.

“When we’re talking about NET TV, data is number one,” Wienardi said. Free-to-air and pay-TV ratings land daily at 10 a.m. and determine whether a program is extended or changed, while MD series simulcast on the channel help widen its reach. The channel’s goal is a place in Indonesia’s top five.

Wienardi said she hopes MD will one day work with Taiwanese directors and producers and “share probably a common ground of storytelling.”

"展览从原朝香宫邸的大客厅拉开帷幕。在这里，以“Marimekko的美学——超越时aj的色彩、形状、图案”为题，通过富有永恒色彩与图案、兼具活动便利性与功能美的服装，介绍了Marimekko的美学。开篇呈现的“唯一的责任是美。唯一的现实是梦。唯一的力量是爱”这句阿尔米·拉蒂亚在14岁时写在日记里的话也令人印象深刻。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "拉蒂亚的目标是打造不受流行左右、超越时空而备受喜爱的服装。本次展览刻意不按年代顺序排列服装，而是根据色彩、版型、母题等对各个房间进行了宽松的分组。因此， 60年前制作的服装与近年制作的服装并排摆放在同一个房间里的情况也是其一大特征。即便如此，几乎感受不到制作年代带来的隔阂。展览本身便传达了拉蒂亚所追求的“永恒（Timeless）”理念。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "在Marimekko的服装中，最具代表性的轮廓是马克西长裙（Maxi dress）、A字裙和迷你裙，而所有这些的共同点是舒适度极高，甚至穿着它们奔跑也毫无问题。大面积运用织物的马克西长裙宽松的版型，直观地体现了“将服装视为画布”的Marimekko美学；而被称为“Mari mini”的自由且极具功能性的迷你裙，则寄托了女性对自由与解放的追求。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/d2772dc9/efdef981-2293-4d74-a9d6-024a847107ba.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "大客厅展场风景", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "展览延续至小会客室的“自然风景——雾与风暴”、大会客室的“秩序与节奏——抽象图案的动感”。每一件服装既是衣物，也可以作为一件精心制作的版画作品来欣赏。在丝网印刷中，由于需要逐层套印颜色，在色彩重叠的部分有时会诞生出不同于原本2种颜色的第3种颜色。这种色彩的重叠，带来了仅靠所选色彩绝无仅有的丰富色调节奏与深邃感。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "此外还有一个值得关注的理念，即Marimekko十分珍视的“完美的残缺（The Perfect "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "在大食堂的“超越时代的花卉图案”中，介绍了Marimekko最具代表性的设计——Unikko（罂粟花）。阿尔米·拉蒂亚最初认为“花朵过于美丽，不适合在纺织品上表现”，但在1964年，迈亚·伊索拉（Maija Isola）提交了一组花卉图案系列，对此提出了异议。伊索拉并没有试图写实地表现花朵，而是将其抽象化，创作出能够传达大自然能量与尺度的图案，从而诞生了Unikko。Unikko成为了Marimekko花卉抽象化悠久传统的起点。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "此外，Unikko具有一种永恒的魅力，即便距离伊索拉进行设计已经过去了60年，依然毫无陈旧之感。在芬兰语中，“Unikko”指的是“罂粟花”，但Marimekko的Unikko在设计之初并非一定只意在表现罂粟花。正因为是不拘泥于现实中花朵的设计，它才不受特定时代或风格的束缚，至今仍散发着当代的魅力。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": Tokyo Art Beatの有料会員機能「ミューぽん」を使うと本展のチケット料金が20%OFFに！ 会員ログイン後に 展覧会ページ からご利用いただけます。ミューぽんの詳細は こちら 。

マリメッコの模様と邸宅の建築が響き合う

2026年夏から 京都府京都文化博物館 を皮切りに始まった、フィンランド生まれのデザインハウス・マリメッコの大規模巡回展 「マリメッコ展 模様のちから」 の東京展が 東京都庭園美術館 で開幕した。会期は12月20日まで。本展は東京での会期終了後、 ひろしま美術館 へと続き、北九州・富山・名古屋・長崎など約2年かけて全国を巡回する予定だ。

1951年に アルミ・ラティア と ヴィリヨ・ラティア 夫妻によって設立されたマリメッコは、鮮やかな色彩と大胆な模様によってファッションからインテリア、テーブルウェア、日常の小物にいたるまで、これまでに3500種類以上のプリント・デザインを世に送り出してきた。本展では、ヘルシンキ建築＆デザイン・ミュージアムやマリメッコ本社から集められた60点を超える様々な年代のドレスやファブリック、制作過程を伝える資料を通して、マリメッコの美学とその創造の背景に迫る。

メインの会場となるのは、1933年、皇室朝香宮家の自邸として建てられた東京都庭園美術館の本館。フランスのアール・デコ装飾を基調とし、日本の意匠も随所に配された空間だ。邸内には花や樹木、波など自然を思わせるモチーフや、幾何学的に構成された模様がいたるところに現れる。建築の細部に息づいた模様が、生命力あふれるマリメッコの模様と響き合い、展覧会の副題である「模様のちから」を体現する場となっている。

プレス内覧会に出席した担当学芸員の 森千花 （東京都庭園美術館 事業係長）は、 「朝香宮邸がもともと人が暮らしてきた邸宅空間であるという性格を生かし、まるでこの場所で実際に使われているかのようにマリメッコのファブリックを取り入れることを試みました。マリメッコのプリントは衣服やインテリアとして暮らしの中に入ることで、その魅力がより鮮明になります。いっぽう、朝香宮邸も建築と室内装飾が一体となり、生活の場をかたち作っています。両者には、デザインが暮らしの中で生きるという共通点があります」 とコメントした。

こうした試みは、マリメッコと同美術館の対話の積み重ねによって実現したという。

マリメッコのホーム＆プリンツ デザイン・ディレクターの ミンナ・ケメル＝クトゥヴォネン は、 「今回、プリントはただのオブジェとしてではなく、体験としてみなさんに提示されます。これらはダイアローグ（対話）を通じて実現しました」 と話し、クリエイティブ・ディレクターの レベッカ・ベイ は 「私たちのアーカイヴには様々なデザインがありますが、それらはすべてアーティストやデザイナーたちとのダイアローグによって生み出されました」 とコメント。マリメッコの創造が、様々な人との対話によって育まれてきたことがうかがえる。

本展ではアートユニット・ plaplax による音とプロジェクションの展示や、ゲスト参加するデザイナー・ 皆川明 によるインスタレーションなど、多様なクリエイションも展開される。さらにデザイナー・ 田部井美奈 によるポスターは、京都展と東京展でキーヴィジュアルが異なるカラーリングになっている。こうした多彩なクリエイターとの協働からも、時代や領域を越えて新たな表現を生み出していく柔軟な姿勢が感じられる。

時を超えるドレスと模様に見る美学

展示は旧朝香宮邸の大広間からスタートする。ここでは「マリメッコの美学―時代を超越する色、形、パターン」と題して、タイムレスな色彩やパターン、動きやすさと機能美に富んだドレスを通してマリメッコの美学が紹介される。最初に示される「ただひとつの責任は、美。ただひとつの現実は、夢。ただひとつの力は、愛」というアルミ・ラティアが14歳のときに日記へ綴った言葉も印象的だ。

ラティアが目指したのは、流行に左右されず、時代を超えて愛されるドレス。今回、あえてドレスは年代順には並べず、色やかたち、モチーフなどによって部屋ごとに緩やかなグルーピングがなされている。そのため、 60年前に作られたドレスと近年のドレスが同じ部屋に並ぶこともあるのが特徴的だ。それでも、制作年代の隔たりはほとんど感じさせない。ラティアが目指したタイムレスという理念を、展示そのものが伝えている。

アルミ・ラティアは、美は様々なかたちで存在し、その対比こそが活力の源であると信じていた。マリメッコには、幾何学模様と花柄、大胆な色使いとモノクローム、グラフィックの精緻さと有機的な自然さなど、相反する表現が共存している。これはマリメッコが「幸福な矛盾」と呼んできた考え方で、異なるものの関係にこそ美が生まれるという思想だ。

そしてもうひとつのベランダである北の間で展開されるのが、ファッションブランド「ミナ ペルホネン」のデザイナー・皆川明とのコラボレーション「皆川 明との新たなクリエイティブ・ダイアローグ―国境・料理機・時を超えて」だ。

皆川がデザインした新作のファブリックとマリメッコのアーカイヴ・ファブリックを用いた、テキスタイルの輪がチェーンのように連なるインスタレーションが、北の間のモダンで開放的な空間と響き合う。プレス内覧会で挨拶に登壇した皆川は、「お声掛けいただいた時、19歳の頃初めてフィンランドのマリメッコを訪れた日のことが思い出されて、コラボレーションの機会をいただけたことがとても嬉しかった」と語った。

美を支えるプリント・メイキングの現場

展示は新館ギャラリーへと続く。「マリメッコの創造力―デザイン制作からプリントメイキングまで」で紹介されるのは、「マリメッコの心臓部」として数多くの作品を生み出してきたプリント・ファクトリーの創造のプロセスとダイナミズムだ。アルミ・ラティアは、プリント・ファクトリーをアートが生まれる場としてとらえており、印刷されたファブリックはひとつの絵画のように、デザイナー名、プリント名、デザイン年が記される。アーティストとしてデザイナーを尊重し、図案やプロダクトのひとつひとつに名称をつけるという伝統は、ラティアの姿勢を示すとともに、マリメッコの精神としていまも受け継がれている。

また、現地に取材したアートユニット・plaplaxによる映像インスタレーションでは、印刷台でのシルクスクリーンプリントの工程が表現される。内覧会に出席したplaplaxの近森基は、「デザイナーがデザインを生み出すにあたりどのようなことを考えたのか、あるいはそこからどのように発想が広がっていくのかということを映像の力を借りて表現しました。それがみなさんに伝わると嬉しいです」と話した。

時代を超えて愛される模様の背景には、自由な発想と、異なる才能が交わる創造の場がある。本展では、そんなマリメッコの「模様のちから」を体感できる。その豊かな創造の軌跡を、実物のファブリックやドレスを通してたどってみてほしい。

article_text:
A Claude Monet painting sold for €50 million ($56.2 million) at Sotheby’s in Paris on Thursday, setting a record for the most expensive artwork ever sold at auction in France.

The painting, Iris , sparked a 45-minute bidding battle between six collectors before selling to a private buyer in Asia, represented on the phone by Sotheby’s deputy chairman Jen Hua. It had been expected to fetch between €22 million and €30 million.

The sale was part of an auction of works from the collection of Jeanne Schlumberger, whose family made its fortune in the oil services industry. Every lot found a buyer, bringing the evening’s total to €74.4 million ($83.7 million), the highest ever for a fine art auction at Sotheby’s Paris. Nearly three-quarters of the lots sold above their high estimates.

Monet was responsible for most of the evening’s fireworks. A second painting, Saule pleureur ou L’Arbre de feu , depicting one of the weeping willows in his garden at Giverny, sold for €9.7 million ($10.9 million). Two more Monets, La Seine à Vernon, Arbres (1894) and La Maison à Travers les Roses , brought in €4.3 million ($4.8 million) and €2.5 million ($2.9 million), respectively.

The four paintings had an unusual history. All passed from Monet to his son Michel before being acquired by the dealer Katia Granoff and eventually joining the Schlumberger collection. They’d remained in private hands for decades.

Jeanne Schlumberger began collecting seriously in the 1950s, working closely with Granoff at a time when Monet’s late paintings weren’t nearly as fashionable as they are today. In 1958, she appears to have helped finance Granoff’s purchase of works from Michel Monet’s studio, giving the dealer access to paintings that would eventually become some of the artist’s most sought-after.

The collection also included three early paintings by Paul Cézanne, but they never made it to the auction block. Sotheby’s announced Thursday that the works, recently designated French national treasures, had been withdrawn following discussions between the Schlumberger family and the city of Aix-en-Provence, Cézanne’s hometown.

The city now intends to acquire the paintings for the Musée Granet, with support from France’s Ministry of Culture.

There was plenty of action beyond Monet. Pierre Bonnard’s La Cueillette des Prunes , which hadn’t been exhibited since 1956, sold for €2.5 million ($2.9 million), more than three times its €800,000 high estimate and a record for the artist at auction in France.

A work on paper by Gustave Moreau, Rêve d’Orient , brought in €1.4 million ($1.6 million), setting a new auction record for a drawing by the artist. Camille Claudel’s La Valse , a bronze cast from 1905, sold for €832,000 ($935,000), more than double its low estimate.

The auction was a strong start to Sotheby’s Paris sales, which continue Friday with auctions devoted to modern art and Surrealism.

All reported sale prices include buyer’s premium.

article_text:
The Taiwan Creative Content Agency (TAICCA) and its partners have invested in 27 projects, backed by NT$5.64 billion ($180 million) in total, including NT$740 million ($23.7 million) from the agency and NT$4.9 billion ($157 million) in private capital, TAICCA chair Sue Wang said at the Taiwan Creative Content Fest (TCCF).

TAICCA brought together its four joint ventures – Chunghwa Digital Cultural and Creative Fund, Enjoy Entertainment Limited Partnership, momomini Kids Content Fund and Joint Journey Creative – to present their slates. The partnerships span nine countries, and Wang said the joint-venture model allows for more professional and precise investment assessments.

Related Stories

Netflix, ‘Elite’ Star Ester Expósito and Locarno Winner Mar Coll Adapt ‘La Regenta,’ a ‘Fresh Female Perspective’ on a Big Spanish Classic (EXCLUSIVE)

Italian Content Investment Dropped 7.4% in 2025 Largely Due to Uncertainty Over Domestic Tax Credits, Rome MIA Market Report Says

Enjoy Entertainment, a partnership between TAICCA and Taiwanese telecom Far EasTone, said it had invested in 15 projects in its first 10 months: eight in film and TV and seven in music and live events. They include horror film “The Rope Curse 4: Kuntilanak,” which took NT$80 million ($2.6 million) at the Taiwanese box office, a franchise record, and VMTheatre Company’s “Don’t Cry, Dancing Girls the Musical,” billed at the event as the first Taiwanese musical to reach Off-Broadway.

On the music side, Enjoy developed the ID. Music Festival with Spotify, which brought 14 Taiwanese acts to two stages in the streamer’s first collaboration with a Taiwanese music event. It also highlighted “Her Voice,” a concert featuring five female performers from Taiwan and South Korea, and indie band Shallow Levée’s “Speak in Silence” project, which pairs the band’s 10th-anniversary album with collaborations with Japanese and Korean musicians and a planned tour of about 50 shows across Taiwan and eight other Asian countries.

Enjoy is also behind an immersive project marking 25 years of work by Taiwanese picture-book artist Jimmy Liao.

Gary Tsai, general manager of Enjoy Entertainment and COO of Far EasTone’s FET Entertainment Service, said the company aims to take Taiwanese original content to international audiences while adapting international IP for local viewers. Through Far EasTone’s streaming service friDay Video, investment and cross-border partnerships, it hopes to help Taiwanese productions expand overseas and create more opportunities for local talent.

Launched in December 2025, momomini Kids Content Fund has made six investments: three in animation, two in live-action and one in drama. COO Phoebe Tsai said the fund weighs each project’s potential impact on the industry alongside content production, talent development and commercial viability. It focuses on children’s content, which Phoebe Tsai said had not previously been treated as a distinct investment category in Taiwan.

Its projects include “Who’s Our Sub Today?,” a comedy-adventure series for children ages 8 to 12; “Feifei,” a picture-book adaptation in development as an animated children’s sitcom; and “Mogu & Perol,” which pairs a French IP with Taiwanese talent. The 39-episode series includes six or seven episodes featuring the culture of Taiwan’s Hakka people, one of the island’s main ethnic groups.

The fund also backed “Mountain Adventure Squad 2,” a children’s outdoor reality show slated to launch in the first quarter of 2027, and “Hello, Mr. President!,” which received an Excellent Screenplay Award from Taiwan’s Ministry of Culture.

Joint Journey Creative’s slate includes Taiwanese films “The Damp,” “All Money Back My Home” and “Suffocation,” as well as Season 6 of Japanese series “ Midnight Diner ,” an international production it is participating in.

The Chunghwa Digital Cultural and Creative Fund totals NT$1 billion ($32 million). Chunghwa Telecom holds 64%, TAICCA 30% through the National Development Fund, E.Sun Financial Holding 5% and fund manager CDCC Capital 1%.

The fund backs film, TV and other programs at the project level. It also takes equity stakes in companies working in content development and production, international distribution and business integration, and new uses for IP across cultural technology, games and music.

Its equity investments include DaMou Entertainment, the production company behind “The World Between Us,” and Horiza Creations, which focuses on international IP operations, data-driven business models and crowdfunding. Its project slate includes “Call of Lobster,” an action comedy spanning Taiwan and South Korea that won the Chunghwa Telecom Award at TCCF’s 2024 pitching competition, and “C’est la Vie,” an eight-episode drama executive produced by and starring Esther Liu, with Tu Cheng-che as screenwriter and director. The fund is also an investor in Shallow Levée’s “Speak in Silence.”

Enjoy Entertainment’s slate also includes “ Our Blues ,” a Taiwanese remake of the 2022 Korean series, which launches globally on Netflix on Dec. 3.

article_text:
Hunter Schafer has undergone bottom surgery, the “Euphoria” star revealed.

“I just had bottom surgery in December, which was amazing, and I love it so much,” Schafer told Elle magazine , referring to the gender-affirming operation that alters a person’s genitals to align with their gender identity.

“For a long time I’ve embraced the gender-expansive part of myself, and I really wanted to try to make that previous body work, because I thought there was something really cool and badass about it,” she said. But, according to Elle, Schafer described “hitting a wall again and again where this theoretical queer utopia didn’t match up with the world she encountered every day, and the way she personally wanted to show up in it.” And so while every trans person is different, a medical transition was the right decision for Schafer.

Related Stories

Tokyo Jury President Rolf de Heer on FIAPF’s New A-List: 'It Matters a Great Deal to Some People, and Not at All to Others'

Ella Langley Retakes No. 1 on Hot 100 From Taylor Swift; Tate McRae's 'Housewife,' Rodrigo/Roan 'Expectations' and Zach Bryan/Lana Del Rey 'Lies' All Bow Big

Schafer described that ability to evolve as the “magical thing about queerness” — that “on an ideological level, it’s about possibility and expansion and growth, and being on that journey and finding yourself.” While she had always viewed her gender identity as more fluid, she has now landed somewhere “flatter,” she described. “I’m a woman. I’m a girl,” she said. Coming to that conclusion required Schafer to wrestle with queerness as a philosophy “versus how it applies and works in real life, in the context of the world that we’re living in.” She said, “I feel like there’s always a tension there.”

Schafer described her recovery from bottom surgery in early 2026, noting that she rented a big apartment and had friends and family visit while she was required to lie flat. “I think my limit was 150 steps per day, which is nothing,” she said of her doctor’s orders.

Schafer, who will next be seen opposite Michelle Yeoh in the Amazon miniseries “Blade Runner 2099,” spoke a couple of years ago about not wanting her identity to overshadow her work, saying she herself had tried to avoid saying the word “trans” during interviews. “It has not just happened naturally by any means. If I let it happen, it would still be giving ‘Transsexual Actress’ before every article ever,” Schafer told GQ in 2024.

“As soon as I say it, it gets blastoff,” she added about when the word “trans” comes up in her interviews. “It took a while to learn that and it also took a while to learn that I don’t want to be [reduced to] that, and I find it ultimately demeaning to me and what I want to do. Especially after high school, I was sick of talking about it. I worked so hard to get to where I am, past these really hard points in my transition, and now I just want to be a girl and finally move on.”

Schafer acknowledged in that interview that “it’s a privilege” to be able to shift focus beyond her gender identity, saying: “It’s been very intentional. I’ve gotten offered tons of trans roles, and I just don’t want to do it. I don’t want to talk about it.”

“I know for a fact that I’m one of the most famous trans people in media right now, and I do feel a sense of responsibility, and maybe a little bit of guilt, for not being more of a spokesperson,” Schafer concluded. “But ultimately, I really do believe that not making it the centerpiece to what I’m doing will allow me to get further. And I think getting further and doing awesome shit, in the interest of ‘the movement,’ will be way more helpful than talking about it all the time.”

Schafer’s first acting rule was Jules in the HBO smash hit “Euphoria,” which made her a celebrity — and a role model for trans people — in her early 20s. Her other roles include “The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes” and the Neon horror movie “Cuckoo.”

article_text:
From Cannes to Havana, and now in Paris: Luis Casadevall , recognized first for his ideas, is today recognized for his photographs.

After an advertising career marked by a Grand Prix at Cannes and more than 50 Lions, Casadevall found a second career in photography. At 76, three images drawn from more than twelve years of photographing Havana will be shown this autumn in three different exhibitions in Paris.

Paris, October 2026. For decades, Luis Casadevall was recognized for creating some of the most striking ideas and images in Spanish advertising. After retiring, he traded briefs and campaigns for long walks, always accompanied by his Leica. He wasn’t looking to start a new career. Yet that is exactly what happened.

Today, his work is exhibited and honored internationally. This autumn, Paris brings together three moments of this second path: three photographs of Havana will be shown, between October and November, in three different group exhibitions.

These images come from a body of more than 65,000 photographs taken in Havana over more than twelve years. They are not a series conceived for these exhibitions and were not designed to be shown together. They share a single city and, above all, a single way of seeing.

Three photographs, three moments

From October 17 to 30, The Ballerina is on view at Galeria Azur’s Paris Pop-Up 2026, at 203 rue Saint-Martin. The work arrives in Paris after Photo London 2026, where its large-format edition sold out. In Paris it is shown in medium format; the large-format edition is no longer available.

From November 11 to 15, Regla Ferry Across Havana Bay will be shown at the Paris Street Photo Festival (2nd edition), at Galerie Kiff & Marais, 17 rue des Gravilliers, Paris. Luis Casadevall was selected by French photographer Catherine Auzuret.

From November 13 to 15, Ensayando (Rehearsal) will be shown for the first time at a fair or exhibition, as part of the 5th edition of the Black & White International Photography Awards (BNW IPA 2026), at Galerie Joseph Minimes. Luis takes part following an award won with another photograph; Ensayando is the image chosen for this presentation. The opening will take place on November 13 at 6 p.m.; the exhibition will be open to the public on November 14 and 15, from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m.

From creating images to discovering them

In advertising, Casadevall worked from a question he put to Salvador Pedreño, his strategic partner for years: “What needs to be said?” The message came first. Then the idea, and finally the image capable of conveying it.

His photography works in reverse. He doesn’t arrive in a city with a thesis and doesn’t look for scenes that answer a preconceived idea. His photographs are never posed or staged. He walks, observes and waits sometimes for hours until a spontaneous event catches his attention. Only afterwards, when he returns to his archives, does the question reappear: what needs to be said?

This process gave rise to Aún nos queda el alma / We Still Have the Soul , published by La Fábrica, curated by Chema Conesa, with a preface by Cuban writer Leonardo Padura. The first edition, printed in 509 copies, sold out in under two months.

A second, international career

In 2026, Casadevall’s photographs were shown at Photo London, PHOTOFAIRS Shanghai, PHotoESPAÑA, in Kyoto, Berlin and Sardinia, while also receiving new international awards. His work will also be shown in Buenos Aires from October 21 to 25, ahead of the Paris exhibitions in November, then in Miami in December during Miami Art Week.

At 76, Casadevall keeps doing what he did when he started photographing: walking, observing and waiting. “Photograph the soul. And photograph with soul.”

Born in Seville in 1950, Luis Casadevall is one of the leading figures of Spanish advertising creativity. For more than a decade, he has found in photography the most personal expression of a way of seeing built over a lifetime.

He began his career in journalism at Grupo Godó before entering the world of advertising. After his first experiences at CreativeShop and MMLB, he founded the agency RCP in Barcelona in the 1980s with Ernesto Rilova and Salvador Pedreño. RCP quickly became one of the reference agencies of the new Spanish advertising creativity and was acquired by Saatchi & Saatchi in 1991.

A year later, Luis Casadevall and Salvador Pedreño founded Casadevall & Pedreño. Over the course of his career, Casadevall’s work has won more than 50 Lions at the Cannes Festival, including a Grand Prix, as well as numerous national and international awards. In 2007, Casadevall and Pedreño received the C de C de Honor from the Club de Creativos, and in 2013 Luis Casadevall was named an honorary member of the Academia Española de la Publicidad.

For Luis Casadevall, however, creativity has never been merely a profession. It is, above all, a way of looking. Over time, that gaze has found its most personal language in photography.

For more than a decade, always accompanied by his Leica, Casadevall has photographed people and cities in different parts of the world: Havana, New York, Tokyo, Miami, Naples, and Palermo, among others. His photography is born of observation and patience. He can stay for hours before a single scene, waiting for that precise instant when an unexpected gesture, glance, or relationship turns an everyday situation into something extraordinary. He never stages his scenes and never directs the people he photographs.

Havana has become his deepest photographic project. For years he has returned to the city again and again, building a vast black-and-white body of work centered less on Cuba as a place than on the people who inhabit it: their relationships, contradictions, desires, sense of humor, vulnerability, dignity, and capacity for resistance.

From this work came, in 2025, his first photography book, Aún nos queda el alma / We Still Have the Soul, published by La Fábrica, curated by Chema Conesa, with a preface by the Cuban writer Leonardo Padura. The first edition sold out in less than two months, and an international English-language edition was published in 2026.

In a short time, his photographic work has also begun an international journey. His photographs have been shown at Photo London, PHOTOFAIRS Shanghai, PHotoESPAÑA, Pinta Buenos Aires, KYOTOGRAPHIE, the Berlin Photo Awards, and BìFoto Fest, as well as at other international events and platforms. His work has received several distinctions, including the BìFoto Award 2026, as well as prizes and mentions at the Berlin Photo Awards and the Street Photographers Foundation Awards.

He is currently pursuing new work made in New York and Naples, while his archives continue to grow.

After a life devoted to creating images capable of communicating an idea, Luis Casadevall now uses photography to seek the instant when an image stops showing only what is before our eyes and begins to reveal something of the person within.

“Photographing the soul. And photographing with a soul.”

LUIS CASADEVALL · PARIS 2026 October 17–30 | Galeria Azur — Paris Pop-Up 2026 The Ballerina · 203 rue Saint-Martin, 75003 Paris

article_translation_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "从戛纳到哈瓦那,现在在巴黎:Luis Casadevall ,首先因他的想法而被认可,今天因他的照片而被认可。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "在广告职业生涯之后,在戛纳大奖和50多狮子之后,卡萨德瓦尔在摄影方面取得了第二次职业生涯,在76年,从哈瓦那拍摄的12年以上拍摄的三张照片将于今年秋天在巴黎举行的三个不同的展览会上展出。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "巴黎,2026年10月,几十年来,路易斯·卡萨德瓦尔被认可为在西班牙广告中创造一些最令人震惊的想法和图像,退休后,他一直在漫长的行程中交易信件和竞选活动,随时伴随他的莱卡,他不想开始新的职业生涯。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "今年秋天,巴黎将聚集这条第二条路的三个时刻:10月至11月之间,哈瓦那的三张照片将在三个不同的集体展览中展出。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "这些图像来自哈瓦那超过12年拍摄的65000多张照片的尸体,这些图像不是这些展览所设计的系列,并且没有被设计为一起展示,它们共享一个单一的城市,最重要的是,一个单一的观看方式。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "3张照片,3个时刻", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "从10月17日至30日,The Ballerina在Galeria Azur’s Paris Pop-Up 2026上展,在203 rue Saint-Martin上展,作品在2026年拍摄后到达巴黎,在那里大型版出售。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "11月11日至15日,在巴黎街头照片节(第2版)展出“Regla Ferry Across Havana Bay”,在巴黎17 rue des Gravilliers的Galerie Kiff & Marais展出。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "从11月13到15,Ensayando(Rehearsal)将首次在展览会或展览会上展出,作为一部分5黑白国际摄影奖(BNW IPA 2026),在画廊Joseph Minimes. 路易斯参加后一项奖项获奖与另一个照片; Ensayando 是图像选择为此演示。13在6下午;展览将于11月向公众开放14和15从11A.M 到7p.m 。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "从创建图像到发现它们", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "在广告中,卡萨德瓦尔从他多年来对他的战略合作伙伴萨尔瓦多·佩德雷诺提出的一个问题上工作:“应该说什么?”这封信首先来了,然后是想法,最后是能够传达的图像。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "他的摄影工作相反,他没有到达一个城市,有一个论文,他不寻找的场景回答一个预见的想法,他的照片从来没有被提交或拍摄,他走路,观察和等待有时几个小时,直到一个自发的事件吸引了他的注意力。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "这个过程引发了Aún nos queda el alma / We Still Have the Soul ,由La Fábrica出版,由Chem Conesa治愈,由古巴作家Leonardo Padura的前面。509副本,售出不到两个月。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "二、国际职业生涯", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "2026年,卡萨德瓦尔的照片在照片伦敦、照片上海、照片西班牙、京都、柏林和萨丁尼亚展出,同时还获得新的国际奖项,他的作品也将于10月21日至25日在布宜诺斯艾利斯展出,在11月的巴黎展览会前,然后在12月的迈阿密展出。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "76岁时,卡萨德瓦尔继续做他开始拍照时所做的事情:走路,观察和等待,“拍照灵魂,拍照灵魂。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "1950年出生于塞维利亚,路易斯·卡萨德瓦尔是西班牙广告创造力的领先人物之一,在摄影中,他已经发现了最个人的表达,一生中建造的视觉方式。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "他在Grupo Godó开始了他的职业生涯,然后进入了广告世界,在CreativeShop和MMLB的第一次体验之后,他在巴塞罗那成立了RCP机构。1980与Ernesto Rilova和Salvador Pedreño. RCP很快成为新西班牙广告创造性的参考机构之一,并由Saatchi & Saatchi在西班牙收购。1991是的", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "一年后,路易斯·卡萨德瓦尔和萨尔瓦多·佩德雷诺创立了卡萨德瓦尔和佩德雷诺,在他的职业生涯中,卡萨德瓦尔的作品获得了更多的成就。50狮子在戛纳节,包括大奖,以及许多国家和国际奖项。2007卡萨德瓦尔和佩德雷诺从创意俱乐部获得C de C de Honor,并在2013路易斯·卡萨德瓦尔(Luis Casadevall)被任命为西班牙广告学院的荣誉成员。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "但是,对于路易斯·卡萨德瓦尔来说,创造力从来没有只是一个职业,它首先是看作的方式,随着时间的推移,这位顾客在摄影中发现了最个人的语言。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "十多年来,卡萨德瓦尔一直伴随他的莱卡,他一直在世界各个地区拍摄了人们和城市:哈瓦那、纽约、东京、迈阿密、那不勒斯和帕勒莫,其摄影是从观察和耐心中产生的,他可以在一个单一场景前几个小时,等待那个准确的时刻,当一个意想不到的动作、眼光或关系将日常情况变成一个奇怪的时刻,他从来没有踏上他的场景,从来没有指向他拍摄的人。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "多年来,他又回到了城里,建造了一个巨大的黑白工作体,集中在古巴作为一个地方,而不是居住在古巴的人:他们的关系,矛盾,愿望,幽默感,脆弱性,尊严,和抵抗能力。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "從這項工作來,在2025,他的第一本照片书,Aún nos queda el alma / We Still Have the Soul,由La Fábrica出版,由Chema Conesa治愈,由古巴作家Leonardo Padura提前出版。2026是的", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "在短时间内,他的摄影工作也开始了一个国际之旅,他的照片在Photo London、PhotoFAIRS Shanghai、PhotoESPAÑA、Pinta Buenos Aires、KYOTOGRAPHIE、Berlin Photo Awards、BìFoto Fest以及其他国际活动和平台上展出,他的作品获得了多项奖项,包括BìFoto Award2026以及柏林照片奖和街头摄影师基金会奖的奖项和提名。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "他目前正在追求在纽约和那不勒斯进行的新工作,而他的档案仍在不断增长。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "经过一生致力于创造能够传达一个想法的图像后,路易斯·卡萨德瓦尔现在使用摄影来寻找一瞬间,当图像停止只显示我们眼前的东西,开始揭示内心的某种东西。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "“拍摄灵魂,拍摄灵魂。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "LUIS CASADEVALL · 巴黎 2026年10月17日至30日 阿扎尔画廊 — 巴黎 流行版 2026 巴黎 · 203 rue Saint-Martin, 75003 巴黎", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "11月11-15巴黎街照片节 -2首頁 〉外文書 〉文學 〉Regla Ferry Across Havana Bay · Galerie Kiff & Marais,17格雷维利尔街75003巴黎", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "11月13日至15日 黑白国际摄影奖 - BNW IPA 2026 Ensayando (Rehearsal) · Galerie Joseph Minimes, 16 rue des Minimes, 75003 巴黎 开幕式: 11月13日下午6点 · 公开: 11月14日下午11点至下午7点", "translated": true}]
excerpt_original: From Cannes to Havana, and now in Paris: Luis Casadevall, recognized first for his ideas, is today recognized for his photographs. After an advertising career […] Cet article Luis Casadevall : Photographs est apparu en premier sur The Eye of Photography Magazine .

title_original: デヴィッド・ボウイの“芸術的な転生”をダンスで描く新作公演『ダンス・フォー・ボウイ』が2028年春から世界で上演へ。Bunkamura×英サドラーズ・ウェルズの国際共同制作
editorial_title_zh: 以舞蹈描绘大卫·鲍伊“艺术转生”的新作演出《舞蹈之鲍伊》将于2028年春起全球上演。Bunkamura与英国萨德勒韦尔斯剧院国际联合制作
editorial_blocks_json: [{"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/2bb4d2b4/d83c38cf-0532-4476-9005-c8ae521b8ec0.jpg?w=2352&q=70&fm=webp", "alt": "", "caption": "《舞蹈之鲍伊（SUBJECT TO CHANGE - A Dance for David Bowie）》主视觉海报", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat", "translated": true}, {"type": "heading", "text": "以鲍伊不断求变以催生全新表现形式的创造方式为起点的全新舞蹈演出", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Bunkamura将携手伦敦世界级舞蹈剧场萨德勒韦尔斯剧院（Sadler's Wells），国际联合制作以大卫·鲍伊（David Bowie）为主题的全新舞蹈作品《舞蹈之鲍伊（SUBJECT TO CHANGE - A Dance for David Bowie）》，并开启世界巡演。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "本演出由今年夏天对三岛由纪夫《金阁寺》进行大胆舞台化改编的西班牙籍导演马科斯·莫劳（Marcos Morau）担任导演。计划于2028年春在卢森堡大剧院迎来世界首演，随后巡回欧洲各地，2028年秋在伦敦萨德勒韦尔斯剧院进行英国首演，2029年春在东京进行亚洲首演。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "大卫·鲍伊不仅对音乐，还对时尚、电影、艺术、表演等广泛领域产生了深远影响，是一位在20世纪后半叶流行文化中留下巨大足迹的艺术家。在其艺术生涯中，他相继创造出“Ziggy Stardust（齐格星尘）”、“Aladdin Sane（阿拉丁·萨恩）”、“Halloween Jack（万圣节杰克）”、“Thin White Duke（瘦白公爵）”等不同的个性化身（Persona），每当塑造出崭新形象时，甚至连嗓音、形体、服装到身份认同都会随之改变。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/e71e4227/893629ac-a7e3-472b-a530-65878107f45f.jpg?q=70&fm=webp", "alt": "", "caption": "大卫·鲍伊　© Sukita", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "莫劳在本作品中描绘的，正是鲍伊结束一个自我、并转生为另一个自我的创造方式。原名中的“Subject to Change”意为“可能会变”或“尚未定型”。莫劳以鲍伊通过不断求变来催生新表现形式的姿态为线索，将变身、再生与自我更新的主题在舞蹈中呈现出来。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/21f80071/da8b916a-6bb3-4fdd-94ab-b03a10b35258.jpg?q=70&fm=webp", "alt": "", "caption": "马科斯·莫劳　© Kazumi Shimomura", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "音乐方面，将使用鲍伊的代表性曲目及其本人的原声人声。通过在世界各地录制的根植于民族音乐的合唱来编排鲍伊的曲目，并与他本人的歌声交织叠合。此外还将融入歌手玛丽亚·阿尔纳尔（Maria Arnal）的歌声，创造出一个仿佛鲍伊的传奇超越时代与国界、传递给不同嗓音的音乐世界。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "此外，曾入选意大利舞蹈奖“Danza&Danza奖”的《Notte Morricone》（2024）中曾有过合作的亚历克斯·雷泽·瓦蒂歇（Alex Raineri-Vatische）与本·梅尔温（Ben Melwin）负责作曲，西尔维娅·杜拉尼奥（Sílvia Delagneau）负责服装，马克斯·格伦策尔（Max Glaenzel）负责舞台美术，共同催生出这部以鲍伊创造力为起点的全新舞台作品。", "translated": true}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://cdn.prod.tabdev.net/asset_files/uploaded/2026-10/cc51e669/fa134c33-3269-4963-bc77-83f8122d8000.jpg?q=70&fm=webp", "alt": "", "caption": "《舞蹈之鲍伊（SUBJECT TO CHANGE - A Dance for David Bowie）》主视觉海报　创意总监／艺术总监：清水正己　摄影师（静态）：下村一喜　服装：山本宽斋事务所　拍摄制作人：土本真纪", "credit": "Tokyo Art Beat", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "以大卫·鲍伊在1973年舞台上穿着而广为人知的服装“TOKYO POP”吸人眼球的主视觉海报由山本宽斋设计。", "translated": true}, {"type": "heading", "text": "导演及萨德勒韦尔斯剧院艺术总监等人的寄语", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "负责导演的马科斯·莫劳，以及主办方萨德勒韦尔斯剧院艺术总监兼联席首席执行官阿里斯特·斯帕尔丁（Alistar Spalding）、东急文化村的寄语如下。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "· 马科斯·莫劳的寄语", "translated": true}, {"type": "quote", "text": "大卫·鲍伊可以说是不断重复着“艺术转生”的艺术家。在他的职业生涯中，他接连不断地创造出新的化身，为了让新的存在诞生，他亲手结束了之前的自己。以Ziggy Stardust（齐格星尘）身份出现，并刻意让该存在终结，随后又以Aladdin Sane（阿拉丁·萨恩）的身份再次现身。以Halloween Jack（万圣节杰克）的身份存活，不久又蜕变为Thin White Duke（瘦白公爵）。每当化身改变，之前的存在便自行消逝。而最后的蜕变则是《Blackstar（黑星）》。鲍伊甚至将自己的死亡也转化为了作品本身的一部分。《舞蹈之鲍伊》正是以这一“转生”循环本身为主题的作品。通过无数次重复死亡与再生而延续生命。描绘的正是这一现象本身。我期待通过舞蹈创作出一部以我自己的方式回应鲍伊在其整个艺术生涯中不断重复的创造与再创造的新作品。将鲍伊终其一生实践的这一循环，这一次通过声音与形体在舞台上实时呈现。能够以一位持续带给我巨大灵感的艺术家为灵感来源创作全新作品，我感到万分荣幸。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "· 阿里斯特·斯帕尔丁 CBE（萨德勒韦尔斯剧院 艺术总监兼联席首席执行官）的寄语", "translated": true}, {"type": "quote", "text": "我们非常高兴能在今天共同宣布，我们的下一个大型国际联合制作项目将是一部从具有先见之明的艺术家大卫·鲍伊身上汲取灵感的作品。作为真正的偶像，鲍伊的艺术始终跨越着边界。他横跨音乐、电影、表演等诸多领域，在各个领域留下了不可磨灭的巨大影响。他绝对是一位放眼全球、将表现形式传递到世界的艺术家。正因如此，本作的核心凝聚着“国际性”，这让我觉得是极其自然的。我非常期待能与杰出的西班牙艺术家兼编舞家马科斯·莫劳以及Bunkamura的各位一同，创作出回应鲍伊在其创作活动中所探索的多元艺术表现形式的全新舞蹈作品，并将其带向世界。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "· 嶋田创（东急文化村 代表取締役社長）的寄语", "translated": true}, {"type": "quote", "text": "非常高兴这一次能够与萨德勒韦尔斯剧院、拉·韦罗纳尔（La Veronal）共同致力于全新的国际联合制作。对于长期以来不断与国内外优秀艺术家及文化设施开展合作的Bunkamura而言，此次项目也是进一步拓展我们迄今所培育网络的宝贵契机。通过与世界各地的合作伙伴共同创作、培育作品并将其呈献给更多观众，我们希望未来能进一步拓宽文化与艺术的无限可能。衷心希望本项目能受到大家的喜爱，并促成国内外文化交流的进一步发展。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "· 高野泰树（东急文化村 策划／首席制作人）的寄语", "translated": true}, {"type": "quote", "text": "我们Bunkamura与马科斯开始探讨这个企划，至今已有将近3年时间。在不断的对话中，作为对他创作产生巨大影响的存在，被屡次提及的便是前作《金阁寺》的三岛由纪夫，以及此次的大卫·鲍伊。我们与马科斯共同孕育的这一构想赢得了萨德勒韦尔斯剧院的共鸣，并发展成为国际联合制作。鲍伊不仅是音乐，还将风格与人格作为表现形式的一部分，无数次重塑了自我。马科斯以舞蹈为起点，横跨戏剧、音乐、美术与时尚来构建独特的舞台世界，他对大卫·鲍伊产生强烈的吸引，可以说是必然的。非常期待他能从鲍伊身上汲取什么，并将其转化为怎样的形体与舞台。我们将与萨德勒韦尔斯剧院这一无与伦比的合作伙伴一起，将鲍伊的故乡伦敦作为重要的制作基地之一，把这部作品推向世界。希望它不仅仅是一部昙花一现的话题之作，而能在一国又一国的文化中与众多观众相遇，并被培育成为一部持久受人喜爱的作品。", "translated": true}]

article_text:
変わり続けることで新たな表現を生み出した、ボウイの創造の在り方を起点とする新作ダンス公演

Bunkamura は、ロンドンの世界的ダンスハウス、 サドラーズ・ウェルズ とともに、 デヴィッド・ボウイ を題材にした新作ダンス作品 『ダンス・フォー・ボウイ（SUBJECT TO CHANGE - A Dance for David Bowie）』 を国際共同制作し、世界ツアーを行う。

本公演は、今夏に三島由紀夫の『金閣寺』を大胆に舞台化したスペイン出身の演出家 マルコス・モラウ が演出を担当。2028年春、ルクセンブルク市立劇場にて世界初演を迎え、その後ヨーロッパ各地を巡り、2028年秋にロンドン・サドラーズ・ウェルズで英国初演、2029年春には東京でアジア初演を予定している。

音楽だけでなく、ファッション、映画、アート、パフォーマンスなど幅広い分野に影響を与え、20世紀後半のポピュラー・カルチャーに大きな足跡を残したアーティストであるデヴィッド・ボウイ。キャリアを通じて、「ジギー・スターダスト（Ziggy Stardust）」、「アラジン・セイン（Aladdin Sane）」、「ハロウィン・ジャック（Halloween Jack）」、「シン・ホワイト・デューク（Thin White Duke）」といった異なるペルソナを次々に生み出し、新しい姿を作るたびに、声や身体、衣裳、アイデンティティまで変化させていった。

本作でモラウが描くのは、ひとつの自分を終わらせ、また別の自分へと生まれ変わっていくというボウイの創造の在り方だ。原題の「Subject to Change」は、「変更される可能性がある」「まだ決まったかたちではない」という意味を持つ。モラウは、変わり続けることで新たな表現を生み出してきたボウイの姿勢を手がかりに、変身や再生、自己更新というテーマをダンスとして立ち上げる。

音楽には、ボウイの代表的な楽曲と本人のオリジナル・ヴォーカルを使用。ボウイの楽曲を、世界各地で録音する民族音楽に根ざしたコーラスでアレンジし、本人の歌声と重ね合わせる。さらに、ヴォーカリストの マリア・アルナル の歌声も交わり、ボウイのレガシーが時代や国境を越えて、異なる声へと受け渡されていくような音楽世界を作り上げるという。

また、イタリアのダンス賞「Danza&Danza賞」にも選ばれた『Notte Morricone』（2024）でもタッグを組んだ アレックス・レーザー・ヴァティシェ と ベン・メールヴァイン による作曲、 シルヴィア・ドゥラニョー による衣裳、 マックス・グレンツェル による舞台美術も加わり、ボウイの創造性を起点とした新たな舞台作品を誕生させる。

1973年にデヴィッド・ボウイがステージで着用したことで知られる衣裳「TOKYO POP」が目を引くメインヴィジュアルは、 山本寛斎 がデザインを手がけた。

演出家やサドラーズ・ウェルズ芸術監督らのコメント

演出を手がけるマルコス・モラウおよび主催のサドラーズ・ウェルズ芸術監督兼共同CEOのアリスター・スポルディング、東急文化村のコメントは以下の通り。

・マルコス・モラウのコメント

デヴィッド・ボウイは、いわば“芸術的な転生”を繰り返したアーティストでした。 彼はそのキャリアを通じて、次々と新たなペルソナを生み出し、次の存在が生まれるために、それまでの自分を自ら終わらせていきました。ジギー・スターダスト（Ziggy Stardust）として現れ、その存在を意図的に終わらせ、アラジン・セイン（Aladdin Sane）として再び姿を現す。ハロウィン・ジャッ（(Halloween Jack）として生き、やがてシン・ホワイト・デューク（Thin White Duke）へと変貌する。ペルソナが変わるたびに、それまでの存在は自ら消えていきました。そして最後の変容が『ブラックスター（Blackstar）』です。ボウイは、自らの死さえも作品そのものの一部へと変えました。『ダンス・フォー・ボウイ』は、この“転生”のサイクルそのものを題材とする作品です。死と再生を何度も繰り返すことによって、生き続けていく。その現象そのものを描きます。ボウイがその芸術人生を通して繰り返してきた創造と再創造に、私なりの方法で、ダンスを通して応答する新たな作品を生み出せることを楽しみにしています。ボウイが生涯を通して実践してきたそのサイクルを、今度は音と身体によって、舞台上でリアルタイムに立ち上げていく。私自身にとっても大きなインスピレーションであり続けるアーティストから着想を得て、新たな作品を創作できることを、大変光栄に思います。

・アリスター・スポルディング CBE（サドラーズ・ウェルズ 芸術監督兼共同CEO）のコメント

私たちの次なる大規模な国際共同制作が、先見性に満ちたアーティスト、デヴィッド・ボウイから着想を得た作品となることを、本日こうして共同で発表できることを大変嬉しく思います。真のアイコンであったボウイの芸術は、常に境界を越えていました。音楽、ファッション、映画、パフォーマンスなど、さまざまな分野を横断し、それぞれに消えることのない大きな影響を残しています。彼はまさに、世界を見据え、世界に届く表現を生み出したアーティストでした。だからこそ、この作品の中心に“国際性”があることは、ごく自然なことだと感じています。卓越したスペインのアーティストであり振付家であるマルコス・モラウ、そしてBunkamuraの皆さんとともに、ボウイがその創作活動の中で探求してきた多様な芸術表現に応答する新たなダンス作品を生み出し、それを世界へ届けられることを、とても楽しみにしています。

・嶋田創（東急文化村 代表取締役社長）のコメント

このたび、サドラーズ・ウェルズ、ラ・ヴェロナルとともに、新たな国際共同制作に取り組めることを大変嬉しく思います。 長年にわたり国内外の優れたアーティストや文化施設との協働を重ねてきたBunkamuraにとって、今回のプロジェクトは、これまで私たちが培ってきたネットワークをさらに発展させる大切な機会でもあります。世界各地のパートナーとともに作品を創り、育て、より多くの皆様にお届けしていくことを通じて、今後も文化・芸術の新たな可能性を広げてまいりたいと考えています。本プロジェクトが多くの皆様に親しまれ、国内外の文化交流のさらなる発展につながることを心より願っております。

・高野泰樹（東急文化村 企画／チーフ・プロデューサー）のコメント

私たちBunkamuraが、この企画についてマルコスと話し始めてから、3年近くになります。対話を重ねる中で、彼の創作に大きな影響を与えてきた存在として、繰り返し名前が挙がったのが、前作『金閣寺』の三島由紀夫と、今回のデヴィッド・ボウイでした。マルコスとともに温めてきたこの構想は、サドラーズ・ウェルズの共感を得て、国際共同制作へと発展しました。ボウイは、音楽だけでなく、スタイルや人格までも表現の一部として、自らを何度もつくり変えてきた人です。ダンスを起点に、演劇、音楽、美術、ファッションを横断しながら独自の舞台世界をつくるマルコスが、ボウイに強く惹かれてきたことは、必然のことのように思います。彼がボウイから何を受け取り、それをどのような身体と舞台に変えていくのか、とても楽しみにしています。サドラーズ・ウェルズというこれ以上ないパートナーとともに、ボウイの故郷ロンドンを重要な制作拠点のひとつとして、この作品を世界へ送り出していきます。一度きりの話題作ではなく、さまざまな国や文化の中で多くの観客と出会い、長く愛される作品に育てていくことができればと思っています。

article_text:
London Film Festival ‘s surprise film on Friday night was “ I Play Rocky ,” Peter Farrelly’s biographical drama about the beginnings of Sylvester Stallone ‘s beloved boxing franchise.

Farrelly was on hand to introduce the movie and shouted out his star, newcomer Anthony Ippolito, who has already earned praise for his portrayal of Stallone. “I could do a TED talk about Anthony Ippolito. This kid is ridiculous,” Farrelly said, adding that the 27-year-old sent in a self-tape before the film team even began what was meant to be a “worldwide search” for who would play Stallone.

'Carrie' Renewed for Season 2 at Amazon

“He heard about the movie, tracked down the script, shot three scenes in his grandmother’s basement on Long Island and sent it to us,” Farrelly continued. “I looked at it like, ‘That’s it.’ We never looked past him.”

Popular on Variety

“I Play Rocky” tells the true story of how Stallone, then a young small-time actor, overcame obstacles to both write and star in the 1976 classic. Alongside Ippolito, it stars AnnSophia Robb as Sasha Czack, Stallone’s wife; Matt Dillon as his father, Frank Stallone Sr.; P.J. Byrne as “Rocky” producer Irwin Winkler; Jay Duplass as director John G. Avildsen and more.

Farrelly added that he’s most proud of the fact that Stallone himself is pleased with the movie. “No matter how well the movie does, how many people like it, if Stallone said, ‘I don’t like it,’ I would be really disappointed,” he said. “And he loved it.”

The film first premiered at Toronto Film Festival last month, where it was up for the People’s Choice Award and generated positive reviews. Variety ‘s chief film critic Owen Gleiberman called the film a “cleverly-crafted crowd pleaser” and praised Ippolito for getting his portrayal of Stallone “just right,” writing: “Watching and listening to Anthony Ippolito, we can believe that Sylvester Stallone is standing right in front of us, though the performance is more than just an awesome impersonation. He’s truly playing Stallone — the sweetly stubborn and dogged person he was at the time.”

“I Play Rocky” is set to hit U.S. and U.K. theaters on Nov. 6.

article_text:
Wednesday, Oct. 14

Mubi will theatrically release the Sundance Grand Jury Prize winning documentary “Nuisance Bear.” The release begins in Los Angeles on Nov. 6 and will open in New York, Canada and the U.K. on Dec. 4.

Per the logline, “Nuisance Bear” “immerses viewers in the experience of a polar bear forced to navigate tourists, wildlife officers, and hunters as climate change delays the freeze and pushes bears closer to human settlements. When a sacred predator is branded a ‘nuisance,’ it becomes unclear who truly belongs in this shared landscape.”

Related Stories

Kevin Delaney Takes Role as NBC News' Head of Digital Content and Subscription

“Nuisance Bear” won the U.S. Grand Jury Prize for Documentary at the Sundance Film Festival 2026, the Werner Herzog Film Award 2026, is nominated for five Critics Choice Documentary Awards, and has won numerous other international awards. The documentary is directed and filmed by Jack Weisman and Gabriela Osio Vanden, produced by Jack Weisman, Gabriela Osio Vanden, Will N. Miller, Teddy Leifer, and Michael Code, edited by Andres Landau, and the music is composed by Cristóbal Tapia De Veer.

*

Antenna Releasing Acquires North American Rights For Nice Hog! Productions’ ‘Secret Menu Beauty Pageant’

Independent distributor Antenna Releasing has acquired North American rights to Nice Hog! Productions’ “Secret Menu Beauty Pageant” directed by Frankie Campisano and SG Egan. The company plans to package the comedy/horror short as part of an anthology feature.

The film debuted on the festival circuit, where it resonated with Antenna’s co-founder Ryan Verrill.

“‘Secret Menu Beauty Pageant’ hit all of my tastebuds perfectly,” Verrill said. “It balances comedy and absurdity in a way that harkens back to much of the formative pop culture that I find true comfort in.”

As co-director, Campisano will produce the anthology, described as “a descent into madness,” curating shorts from emerging filmmakers. Antenna aims to introduce audiences to the next generation of auteur filmmakers, preparing creatives for their feature debuts through a series of these anthologies that will premiere theatrically before physical media release.

“I’m deeply passionate about films of all flavors, but especially the weird and wild stuff that far too often never makes it past midnight screenings on the festival circuit,” Campisano said. “It means the world to our team that the folks at Antenna connected with ‘Secret Menu Beauty Pageant,’ and I’m honored to pay that forward by championing some of the most exciting shortform work I’ve seen from our peers in the independent film scene.”

*

‘Paper Tiger’ Costume Designer Amy Roth to be Honored at Key West Film Festival

The Key West Film Festival announced that Amy Roth will receive the Golden Key Award for Excellence in Costume Design for her work in the festival’s opening film “Paper Tiger.”

Starring Adam Driver, Scarlett Johansson and Miles Teller, “Paper Tiger” follows “a naïve engineer, Irwin (Miles Teller) who accepts a seemingly lucrative business proposition from his brother, Gary (Adam Driver), a former cop. But when Irwin witnesses something he wasn’t meant to see at the Gowanus Canal, the brothers find themselves pulled into a dangerous confrontation with the newly emerging Russian mafia. As the threat of violence escalates, Irwin’s wife Hester (Scarlett Johansson) sounds the alarm, Irwin desperately tries to protect his family, and Gary is forced to make an impossible choice to save those he loves.”

Roth will attend the screening followed by a conversation about her work moderated by Alison Willmore of Vulture.com and Esther Zuckerman of The Wall Street Journal.

Neon will release the film beginning Nov. 13, with a wide release on Nov. 25.

Tuesday, October 13

Quentin Tarantino to Attend AFI Fest for ‘Once Upon A Time In Hollywood’ Screening and Conversation

Quentin Tarantino will attend AFI Fest 2026 for a conversation and special screening of his “Once Upon A Time In Hollywood.” The screening and conversation takes place on Friday, Oct. 23 at the TCL Chinese Theatre.

The event comes in anticipation of David Fincher’s new Netflix film “The Further Mis-Adventures Of Cliff Booth,” in which Brad Pitt reprises his role as Cliff Booth from Tarantino’s 2019 film.

“As the world awaits “The Further Mis-Adventures Of Cliff Booth,” AFI is proud to celebrate where it all began,” Bob Gazzale, AFI President & CEO, said. “And to do so with one of the greatest storytellers of our generation is a gift to all who love the movies.”

The 40th annual AFI Fest will run Oct. 21 to 25, screening over 150 films at the TCL Chinese Theatres in Hollywood. The festival will open with the U.S. premiere of “Wildwood” and close with “Being Heumann.”

‘Anarchy in High Heels: The Story of Les Nickelettes’ Documentary to Screen at LA Femme International Film Festival

Betsy Newman’s “Anarchy in High Heels: The Story of Les Nickelettes” is set to screen Oct. 25 as part of the 22nd annual LA Femme International Film Festival.

The documentary chronicles the women’s theater troupe that emerged in San Francisco in the 1970s and ‘80s. Les Nickelettes challenged gender stereotypes, broke taboos and claimed unprecedented freedom.

The film is based on founding artistic director Denise Larson’s memoir “Anarchy in High Heels.” Director Newman is also a former member and the company’s first female director. Larson serves as producer and writer, alongside executive producer Debra Pollock and producers Valerie Hellmond and Judith Rain.

“Anarchy in High Heels” will be shown Oct. 25 at 10 a.m. at Regal Cinemas at the Sherman Oaks Galleria in Los Angeles. The festival runs Oct. 22-25.

Monday, October 12

‘ Wild Horse Nine ’ Screenings in 35mm at Alex Theatre

Martin McDonagh’s “Wild Horse Nine” will be screened in 35mm at The Alex Theater in Glendale.

The film released by Searchlight Pictures will screen on Nov. 5 and Nov. 12.

Set in 1973, “Wild Horse Nine” follows two CIA officers (John Malkovich and Sam Rockwell) who are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island shortly before the Chilean military coup that overthrew socialist president Salvador Allende. Steve Buscemi, Tom Waits and Posey round out the ensemble.

Inspired by Ektachrome, a color-reversal film stock widely used during the 1970s, this presentation allows viewers to immerse themselves into the vivid colors and style of the 1973 Easter Island landscape.

“Wild Horse Nine” opens in theaters nationwide on Nov. 6.

Proof Inc. Announces First New York Studio

Proof Inc., the production company focused on visualization, has opened its first New York studio, with filmmaker Ari Aster’s next feature as its inaugural project.

Founder and CEO Ron Frankel will oversee the New York operation, splitting his time between the company’s Los Angeles and New York studios. The company has provided visualization services for productions such as the “Jurassic World” franchise, the “Harry Potter” TV series, “Avatar: Fire and Ash,” and “Stranger Things.” Proof New York now joins Proof London, Proof Australia, and Proof Inc., which has been based in Los Angeles since 2002.

“Establishing Proof’s first New York studio is a full-circle moment, both personally and professionally,” Frankel said. “I began my career in visualization in Manhattan in the late ’90s, when the community of 3D artists and animators was relatively small. Today, New York has an extraordinarily deep pool of creative talent and filmmakers. Establishing a permanent presence here allows us to become part of that community and build on the relationships and creative collaborations that have always been at the heart of Proof.”

title_zh: 不只是倖存，而是在派對後的夜路能感到安全──專訪《沒有的派對》導演丹妮亞拉・麥蘭妮・胡勒
summary_zh: 来源摘录：詩意在語言失效的創傷裡，為生命帶來了可能的出口，《沒有的派對》開拍前夕，丹妮亞拉讀起安妮．艾諾的「私」小說，其中影響她甚深的是《記憶無非徹底看透的一切》，「書裡面有一段，是安妮．艾諾認為在經歷了某件事情之後，我們就有⋯⋯她的用法是『不可剝奪的權利』——我們擁有不可剝奪的權利，可以去書寫它。」 這篇文章 不只是倖存，而是在派對後的夜路能感到安全──專訪《沒有的派對》導演丹妮亞拉・麥蘭妮・胡勒 最早出現於 釀電影 。

採訪、撰文／黃曦 專訪攝影／ioauue 劇照提供／台灣國際女性影展 採訪實習／沈映瑄 責任編輯／黃曦 核稿編輯／黃曦

《沒有的派對》電影劇照／劇照提供：台灣國際女性影展

2017 年，「＃Me Too」運動大規模擴散至全球社群，近十年後的 2026 年 9 月，「＃I Am Jane Doe.」成為新的社群標籤，曾經受性暴力、性騷擾傷害的當事人，紛紛化名為 Jane Doe，既是表達性暴力、性騷擾議題在這十年間仍未減少的控訴，也代表著女性將與 Jane Doe 永遠站在一起。

時間拉回 2024 年 10 月的美國名校康乃爾大學，化名為 Jane Doe 的女學生在大學兄弟會的派對上，遭到多名男性輪流性侵，後來完全失去意識。在輿論爆發之前，七名被告男性仍是民事訴訟的被告人，直到引發社群輿論、示威抗議後，目前案件已重新進入刑事偵查，檢方也準備將此案交付大陪審團共同審理。

在另一面的討論聲浪中，有部分說辭提及 Jane Doe 在當時是同意發生（部分）性行為的，也有人指控 Jane Doe 在 Phi Kappa Psi 兄弟會飲酒、吸食大麻等行為；在事件發生後，Jane Doe 在校園聽見關於自己的傳言，最終在三週後向校方報告，表示自己「百分之百確定，自己被強暴了。」（I can say with 100% confidence I was raped.）

根據紐約州法律，性暴力受害人如欲主張自己受藥物、酒精影響，而無法判斷、表達其合意權，此前必須證明自己是非自願／受脅迫才使用藥物、酒精──然而當事人是否自願同意性行為的發生，與當事人自願／非自願使用藥物、酒精後有無表達合意的能力，根本上是兩件不同的事。

除了法律定義的問題與現實社會多所扞格，更有本質上的不合理之處，此案的細節更令人感到驚愕。有一段事發當晚凌晨的兄弟會群組聊天紀錄，其中一人拍下 Jane Doe 意識模糊的模樣，並在 70 多人的兄弟會群組表示，「樓上有一名『free pussy』，所有人都能上來與她發生性行為」，而自訊息發出的凌晨 1 點 42 分，直到 Jane Doe 清醒的清晨時分，並未有任何人出言制止、報警處理。

這是整起事件中，最令人感到恐懼、憤慨的。集體沉默、成為幫兇的 70 人，指向當前社會對性暴力事件、性暴力加害人的容忍，與父權系統固守的有毒男子氣概，如何默許大規模的、系統性的厭女結構，使得侵害仍如日常般，發生在我們的生活裡。

《沒有的派對》電影劇照／劇照提供：台灣國際女性影展

根據近年的世界各國統計資料，在美國平均一天有 12 名女性遭殺害，巴西為 10 至 11.5 名女性，德國為 0.95 名女性，法國為 0.67 名女性，日本為 0.44 名女性，台灣則為 0.10 至 0.16 名女性；在犯罪學的性別研究中，謀殺行為有極為鮮明的性別傾向，而在女性謀殺事件中，超過半數為親密伴侶、家庭成員之謀殺事件，遭其他熟人（如朋友、鄰居、同事等）謀殺的比例則為 20% ～ 25%，而在後者的謀殺行為中，多半伴隨長期跟騷的情況。

即使相較於前十年，女性謀殺率略有下降，不過在德國、法國等性別平等指數較高的國家，女性謀殺率的降幅仍未有顯著的降幅。更進一步的數字則指出，對比十年前後的謀殺率，在過去十年治安有顯著改善的國家，因為街頭犯罪、幫派衝突的減少，男性謀殺率有明顯的降幅。

近年已有多數國家開始將因性別動機而殺害女性（Femicide）的案件單獨列法，然而女性遭謀殺的頻率，仍難以透過公共治安的改善，而有較大程度的下降。亦即，針對女性／針對性別的謀殺，不只是單純的治安指標，更關乎於該國家在父權觀念、性別權力結構等本質上的觀念，是否有長足的進步。

事發距今已逾 15 年，17 歲的青春時節，丹妮亞拉・麥蘭妮・胡勒（Daniela Magnani Hüller）在放學途中的公車站，遭長期跟蹤、騷擾她的男同學持刀攻擊；三名行人深怕受到波及，於是不敢上前救助，當時共同承辦此案的男警員，在醫院向她表示，希望她不要因此對人性失去信心。

事件之後，丹妮亞拉離開德國、回到巴西故鄉休養，先後於德國帕紹大學媒體與傳播學系、慕尼黑電視與電影學院修習紀錄片執導；首部紀錄長片《沒有的派對》（Sometimes, I Imagine Them All at a Party）以自身經驗出發，並於 2026 年柏林影展首映，而在今年的 第 33 屆台灣國際女性影展 廣受迴響。

而在《沒有的派對》於臺灣放映前夕，桃園的一名盧姓年輕女性，在清晨步行返家途中，遭 36 歲的陌生男性林志峰尾隨、闖入其租屋處，後持刀殺害盧姓女子，並在屋內放火，企圖焚屍滅證。盧姓女子被救出後，最終因傷勢過重而宣告不治。

《沒有的派對》導演丹妮亞拉・麥蘭妮・胡勒（Daniela Magnani Hüller）專訪。／專訪攝影：ioauue

「沒有的派對」的英文片名「Sometimes, I Imagine Them All at a Party」，是丹妮亞拉在倖存之後，經常想起在事件中不幸喪生的女性。 她想著，如果這些女性沒有被謀殺，那麼大家或許能參加同一場派對；更進一步的指涉則是，有成千上萬的女性，都在父權共謀的「派對」裡，失去了活著的權利。

「小」至言語、眼神的暗示或騷擾，「大」至對身體的侵害、對生命的謀殺，丹妮亞拉認為自己是在事發的十年之後，才感覺到自己的生命狀態已經有所不同， 「其實在創傷剛發生時，我沒有辦法感覺到太多，對自己的狀態也是不清楚的，只不過現在我已經感覺到自己好很多了。如果現在要回頭觀看『事件』本身，反而會帶來新的傷害，只是我想起有許多的女性，可能都有過相同的遭遇，這樣的事情會發生在任何女性身上，想到這件事情，便讓我有動力拍攝這部作品。」

丹妮亞拉提及，拍攝《沒有的派對》的動機，並非是要處理創傷、療癒自我，而是她要用一個紀錄片工作者的角度，思考、捕捉暴力背後的社會結構，以及暴力在十年後仍然持續發生的原因。

在電影中，丹妮亞拉與當時的法官、醫生、檢察官，與學校的輔導老師、同學等案件相關人進行訪談，嘗試透過個人的受害經驗，指出社會結構的本質問題；除了丹妮亞拉自己對事件的口述，在絕大多數的訪談中，都圍繞著旁觀者當年的沉默，與沉默背後、旁觀帶來的另一種暴力。

比如，在班上同學都已經察覺男同學長期的視線騷擾時，小至同儕出言制止、大至校方採取行動，這個社會在未能實際解決問題之前，能否有更實際的預防措施，可以即早介入以避免最糟糕的情況發生？

丹妮亞拉特別選擇在開放、明亮的空間進行訪談，絕大多數時候也不讓自己出現在訪談畫面之中，為的便是要降低事件本身與個人的連結，而可能讓私密的對談，提升至可供大眾共同理解、參與、直面社會現況的狀態。

《沒有的派對》電影劇照／劇照提供：台灣國際女性影展

《沒有的派對》導演丹妮亞拉・麥蘭妮・胡勒（Daniela Magnani Hüller）專訪。／專訪攝影：ioauue

「透過在公共空間進行訪談，與較廣的鏡位設計，可以避免呈現出個人故事的氛圍，讓事件本身具有公共性；此外，在設計訪談問題時，我也想盡量提到受到騷擾、暴力、侵害的女性，都可能面對的問題，所以在這些訪談中的主體，並不是我，而是這些敘事者，他們的主體性便代表著公共社會的一個切面。」

在電影正式拍攝之前，丹妮亞拉與案件相關人士，進行了約莫一年的通信、見面，所有成功聯繫上的人，最終也都同意進行拍攝，身兼案件當事人、製片聯繫、導演等多重身分，她也強調自己並非是要回到當年、進行咎責，更無意在片中將受訪者描摹成負面、糟糕的形象。

丹妮亞拉希望這段記憶可以不只是她的， 「在事件發生之後，我面對的這些案件相關人，他們身後都代表著一個系統，比如學校、醫院、警方、律法，但是這些人究竟是什麼樣的人，我其實一無所知；但是現在，我更希望能夠認識他們『本身』。」

在多年後的訪談中，輔導老師才提起在事件發生之前，便已知悉男同學曾在社群網路對丹妮亞拉出言恐嚇、其父母也曾經報警，只不過老師在當時希望能「幫忙緩和一下情勢，因為自己是樂於助人的類型」；老師還提及，自己其實也對該名男同學心生畏懼，且對當年未有更積極的預防措施感到懊悔。

另一方面，透過電影穿插丹妮亞拉的生活片段、回憶自述，看見暗藏在生活細節裡的問題， 「某天我告訴媽媽，班上有個男生會一直盯著我看，我說我覺得很煩，我沒有跟她說我害怕。有時我真希望當初有說出來，但我不知道，說了是否會有改變，只是母親說她並不感到意外，因為我上學都會打扮。如果我不想被看，早上就不該在浴室待那麼久。」

即使從一開始，丹妮亞拉便決定，不會在片中放入她與家人、朋友討論創傷事件的相關畫面，但她也持續地思考，在事件發生前後，家庭成員帶給她的幫助，與可能的細小傷害。

《沒有的派對》導演丹妮亞拉・麥蘭妮・胡勒（Daniela Magnani Hüller）專訪。／專訪攝影：ioauue

《沒有的派對》電影劇照／劇照提供：台灣國際女性影展

「在片中，可以看到我和姊姊有著緊密、親密的關係，雖然在相處時我們不大會談到這件事，但我是在事件發生約兩年後，搬到巴西與姊姊一起生活。在巴西的生活，不只是遠離了創傷事件，我也感覺到自己更加自由，有機會可以享受生命。」

電影中，分別有三首巴西歌曲：以 Bossa Nova、Samba 等樂風進行創作的傳奇歌手 Chico Buarque 的〈Roda Viva〉，崛起於七〇年代、樂風涵蓋迷幻搖滾、合成器音樂、Bossa Nova & Acoustic 等面向的搖滾女王 Rita Lee（1947－2023）的〈Cor de Rosa Choque〉，與結合 Samba-Jazz、Samba-Canção 等風格的 Bossa Nova 四重唱女聲團體「Quarteto em Cy」的〈Tudo Que Você Podia Ser〉。

《沒有的派對》以雲霄飛車的畫面，搭配寫於巴西軍事獨裁年代的〈Roda Viva〉，詩人面對巨大歷史的無奈，自此與世界內面的傷害彼此連結，「它寫著一個人細心地澆灌自己的玫瑰花叢，然而突如其來的暴風雨，卻將一切連根拔起；我們坐在生命的小船上，一心想駛向某個遠方，然而命運的急流卻將我們推向未知，就像我沒有辦法控制自己的人生，會在十多年前受到傷害，也沒辦法預料到當前的生命會有這樣的發展。」

「我認為巴西的音樂帶有一種天生的詩意與韌性，在巴西的文化裡，即使人們曾經遭遇歷史、生活的傷害，但音樂仍然是明亮的，就像是我們看見了痛苦，但依然選擇跳舞。」 作為一名女性主義者的 Rita Lee，則透過歌曲戲謔解構社會之於女性的刻板印象，丹妮亞拉則透過霓虹色的拼接影像，嘗試進行第二次的提問──向女人經過父權系統的拼貼而組成的「社會性」進行質問。

而最後一首歌曲，或許也回到「Sometimes, I Imagine Them All at a Party.」的想像， 「如果我們不活在恐懼中，我們的人生將有多少的可能性──這是〈Tudo Que Você Podia Ser〉的內容，即使這首歌也誕生自抵抗獨裁的歷史語境，但這也和女性身處於暴力之下的處境如出一轍。重新聆聽這些歌，已經為我帶來嶄新的詮釋和理解，這也可能為世界帶來新的意義。」

《沒有的派對》導演丹妮亞拉・麥蘭妮・胡勒（Daniela Magnani Hüller）專訪。／專訪攝影：ioauue

《沒有的派對》導演丹妮亞拉・麥蘭妮・胡勒（Daniela Magnani Hüller）專訪。／專訪攝影：ioauue

詩意在語言失效的創傷裡，為生命帶來了可能的出口，《沒有的派對》開拍前夕，丹妮亞拉讀起了 安妮．艾諾（Annie Ernaux） 的「私」小說，其中影響她甚深的是出版於 2000 年的 《記憶無非徹底看透的一切》（L'Événement） ， 「書裡面有一段，是安妮．艾諾認為在經歷了某件事情之後，我們就有⋯⋯她的用法是『不可剝奪的權利』──我們擁有不可剝奪的權利，可以去書寫它。」

同樣以自傳體鋪展敘事，但在安妮．艾諾的書寫中，藉由她赤誠、坦露的深入自己的記憶與生命，我們反而更能從中照見父權系統與女性之間的扞格，與時代、環境對個人的影響。

之所以選擇以碎片化的方式構成電影，丹妮亞拉認為自己的敘事方式，也同樣受安妮．艾諾的啟發。在回到記憶的現場時，她更想知道那些至今仍留在她心裡的回憶、言語，為什麼在多年後仍是如此清晰。

比如案發之前，母親曾和她說過的話，或是在案發之後，陌生的警官帶給她的一句話，這些都讓她感覺到，自己與那些未能倖存、或者幸運倖存的女性特別靠近。

《沒有的派對》導演丹妮亞拉・麥蘭妮・胡勒（Daniela Magnani Hüller）專訪。／專訪攝影：ioauue

「有很多人沒有活下來，也有人即使活了下來，卻沒有力氣說出自己的故事，但是我有機會繼續過生活，甚至在多年後有力量拍攝這部作品，都讓我覺得自己必須將它完成。雖然對一個曾經被跟蹤、騷擾、傷害的人來說，作為一個電影導演、必須出席許多公開場合，這可能不是一件有安全感的事，但我不想要一直活在恐懼之中，我不想再躲起來了。」

在《記憶無非徹底看透的一切》的尾聲，安妮．艾諾寫有一段： 「藉著這本書，我消除了這僅有的罪惡感（關於墮胎）。我所經歷的一切，包含了社會與心理的起因，但是其中有個理由，我再確定不過：正是發生了這種事，我才能有所頓悟。我的人生，也許只有唯一一個真正的目標：將我的身體、感覺、想法轉化為文字，也就是某種清楚易懂、普遍性的東西，好讓我的生命完完全全融進其他人的腦海和生活。」

即使放眼世界有 《黑箱日記》（Black Box Diaries，2024） 、 《世界的主人》（The World of Love，2025） 、 《寶貝對不起》（Sorry, Baby，2025） 等千萬女性講述著不同層面的、針對女性的傷害，在當代重新閱讀安妮．艾諾、持續透過文學指認生命的傷害，也難以讓我們樂觀地認為，世界將因此有長足的改變。

然而丹妮亞拉卻提到，如果電影裡的輔導老師、檢察官、醫生⋯⋯， 在與她──只是作為丹妮亞拉・麥蘭妮・胡勒的她──見面之後，將有機會在未來做出不同的決定，那麼將來的我們，也就有了更多的可能性，可以在派對後的夜路感到安全。

《釀電影》女人沒有鄉愁──𝟤𝟢𝟤𝟨 台灣國際女性影展專題／圖像提供：釀電影

將於 2026 年 10 月 16 日正式開展的第 33 屆女性影展，以「非分擾動 Into the Drift」為年度視覺，藉由流動、穿梭的視覺意象，向當代持續變動的疆界、關係發出提問，嘗試在一個世紀的電影裡，尋找錨定自身位置，重新想像自由的樣貌。

《釀電影》編輯室以 「女人沒有鄉愁」 為策展專題，延伸「流動」一詞作為觀看當代世界的方法，循著穿行於城市與鄉野、家庭與個體、戰爭與和平之間的選擇，即從無法無家、無法有家，又何處不是家的概念出發，嘗試看見女性在巨大歷史的移動軌跡之中，曾經被隱匿、邊緣的流離。

當「鄉愁」經常性地被放置在傳統父權結構底下，指涉國族敘事框架、血緣根源、既定秩序的眷戀與歸返，自破除疆界而起的遊牧，便關乎於女性電影中的身分、身體、時間與抗爭之路徑。

本次專題委邀策展人陳慧穎進行訪問，自「屬於她的遊蕩」單元的六部電影作品展開，重新爬梳半世紀的世界之變，與存於其中的不變；同時亦邀請獨立評論人陳穎，深入分析「屬於她的遊蕩」單元中，三部來自八〇、九〇年代的導演首作，以「移動」與「身體性」為軸，試論空間為性別運動、女性主義所開創的嶄新變革。

圍繞著「跨越」、「移動」的概念，今年的「焦點影人」單元為非裔法國電影導演莎拉・馬羅多羅（Sarah Maldoror，1929－2020），本次也將收錄獨立評論人黃曦，自多部經典電影爬梳女性主義與反殖民運動、去殖民途徑的抵抗力量。

延續關於時間、時代之思索，本專題另有三篇獨立評論，分別由獨立評論人許騰云、小說家趙鴻祐與新銳評論人黎思行執筆。透過普拉迪・克里申（Pradip Krishen）《安尼閣來舞這齣》（In Which Annie Gives It Those Ones，1989）回到七〇年代，與作家阿蘭達蒂・洛伊（Arundhati Roy）進行跨越世代對話；接著隨克萊兒・西蒙（Claire Simon）《我們的青春與安妮艾諾》（Writing Life – Annie Ernaux Through the Eyes of High School Students，2025）與當代學子的對讀，將書寫轉化為面向未來、身分的路徑；最後由琳恩・薩克斯（Lynne Sachs）《相遇皆有痕》（Every Contact Leaves a Trace，2025）的實驗性展開評析，記述散文電影無有時間，卻凝刻空間、記憶的痕跡。

最後，本專題亦與《沒有的派對》（Sometimes, I Imagine Them All at a Party，2026）導演丹妮亞拉・麥蘭妮・胡勒（Daniela Melanie Goode）展開深入對談，自導演十餘年後執起攝影機，透過多重影像媒介將創傷記憶轉化為與公共對話，甚至對抗體制的政治力量，以期提出一種嶄新的、當代的對話空間是──「女人沒有鄉愁」的起點不在故土，而在踏出疆界、凝視創傷、重構語言與時間的游蕩中，我們如何在生命的蜿蜒之中，持續闖蕩？
